# RAG Service API Reference - Future Roadmap
page_texts.2:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#overview]

## Overview

The RAG Service API Reference represents a comprehensive roadmap for future development, defining a complete enterprise-grade API specification for retrieval-augmented generation capabilities. This document establishes the architectural foundation for advanced document management, semantic search, conversational interfaces, and AI-powered content retrieval that will extend beyond the current implementation.

This future API specification encompasses authentication frameworks, versioned endpoints, comprehensive error handling, and multi-language SDK support designed for scalable enterprise deployment. The roadmap addresses complete document lifecycle management, advanced search capabilities with filtering and ranking, conversational chat interfaces with session management, and robust monitoring and observability features.

> **⚠️ IMPLEMENTATION STATUS**: This document describes a comprehensive API specification that is **NOT YET IMPLEMENTED**.
> For the current implementation capabilities, see [`api_reference.md`](api_reference.md).
> This document serves as the development roadmap for future API evolution.

### Key Benefits

- **Enterprise Authentication** - JWT-based token authentication with role-based access control and session management capabilities
- **Comprehensive Document Management** - Complete document lifecycle including upload, processing, metadata management, and version control
- **Advanced Search Capabilities** - Semantic search with filtering, ranking, multiple query types, and AI-generated responses
- **Conversational Interface** - Session-based chat functionality with context awareness and conversation history management
- **Developer Experience** - Multi-language SDKs, comprehensive code examples, and detailed integration documentation
- **Operational Excellence** - Rate limiting, monitoring, webhooks, and enterprise-grade error handling for production deployment

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#enterprise-jwt-token-authentication]

### Enterprise JWT Token Authentication

The RAG Service implements industry-standard JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication to secure API access and manage user sessions. This authentication framework provides stateless token-based security with configurable expiration policies and role-based access control capabilities.
page_texts.7:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#token-acquisition-process]

#### Token Acquisition Process

Authentication tokens are obtained through credential-based authentication against the service's identity provider. The token acquisition process validates user credentials and returns a signed JWT containing user identity and authorization claims.

```http
POST /auth/token
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "username": "your_username",
  "password": "your_password"
}
```

**Successful Authentication Response:**

```json
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 3600,
  "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "scope": "read write",
  "user_id": "user_12345"
}
```
page_texts.8:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#authorization-header-implementation]

#### Authorization Header Implementation

All authenticated API requests require the JWT token in the Authorization header using the Bearer authentication scheme. The token must be included with each API call to access protected resources.

```http
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
```
page_texts.9:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#token-refresh-and-security]

#### Token Refresh and Security

JWT tokens have configurable expiration times to balance security and user experience. The authentication system supports refresh tokens for seamless session renewal without requiring user re-authentication.

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#service-endpoints-and-environment-configuration]

### Service Endpoints and Environment Configuration

The RAG Service API follows RESTful conventions with environment-specific base URLs and semantic versioning to ensure backward compatibility and smooth service evolution. API versioning enables controlled feature rollouts and maintains compatibility across client implementations.

**Environment-Specific Base URLs:**

- **Development Environment**: `http://localhost:8001`
- **Production Environment**: `https://api.<organization-domain>.com`

**API Version Strategy:**

- **Current Version**: `v1`
- **Versioned Endpoint Pattern**: `{base_url}/api/v1`
- **Version Headers**: Optional `API-Version` header support for future compatibility

**Complete Endpoint Structure:**

```text
{environment_base_url}/api/{version}/{resource}
```

Example: `https://api.<organization-domain>.com/api/rag/v1/search`
page_texts.16:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#http-status-codes]

### HTTP Status Codes

| Status Code | Description           | When Used                         |
| ----------- | --------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| 200         | OK                    | Successful GET, PUT requests      |
| 201         | Created               | Successful POST requests          |
| 204         | No Content            | Successful DELETE requests        |
| 400         | Bad Request           | Invalid request data              |
| 401         | Unauthorized          | Missing or invalid authentication |
| 403         | Forbidden             | Insufficient permissions          |
| 404         | Not Found             | Resource not found                |
| 422         | Unprocessable Entity  | Validation errors                 |
| 429         | Too Many Requests     | Rate limit exceeded               |
| 500         | Internal Server Error | Server-side errors                |
page_texts.17:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#error-codes]

### Error Codes

| Error Code             | Description                  |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR`     | Request validation failed    |
| `AUTHENTICATION_ERROR` | Authentication failed        |
| `AUTHORIZATION_ERROR`  | Insufficient permissions     |
| `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`   | Requested resource not found |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`  | API rate limit exceeded      |
| `AI_SERVICE_ERROR`     | AI service integration error |
| `PROCESSING_ERROR`     | Document processing error    |

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#health-check]

#### Health Check

Check service health and availability.

```http
GET /health
```

**Response:**

```json
{
  "status": "healthy",
  "service": "rag-service",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "timestamp": "2025-08-24T12:00:00Z",
  "uptime": "2h 15m 30s"
}
```
page_texts.23:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#upload-document]

#### Upload Document

Upload a new document for processing and indexing.

```http
POST /api/v1/documents
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

file: [binary file data]
title: "Document Title"
metadata: {"author": "John Doe", "category": "research"}
```

**Response:**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "doc_123456",
    "title": "Document Title",
    "filename": "research_paper.pdf",
    "size": 1048576,
    "status": "processing",
    "metadata": {
      "author": "John Doe",
      "category": "research",
      "upload_date": "2025-08-24T12:00:00Z"
    }
  }
}
```
page_texts.24:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#list-documents]

#### List Documents

Retrieve a list of all documents with pagination.

```http
GET /api/v1/documents?page=1&limit=20&sort=created_at&order=desc
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

**Parameters:**

- `page` (optional): Page number (default: 1)
- `limit` (optional): Items per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `sort` (optional): Sort field (default: created_at)
- `order` (optional): Sort order (asc/desc, default: desc)
- `filter` (optional): Filter by metadata fields

**Response:**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "documents": [
      {
        "id": "doc_123456",
        "title": "Document Title",
        "filename": "research_paper.pdf",
        "size": 1048576,
        "status": "processed",
        "created_at": "2025-08-24T12:00:00Z",
        "updated_at": "2025-08-24T12:05:00Z",
        "metadata": {
          "author": "John Doe",
          "category": "research"
        }
      }
    ],
    "pagination": {
      "page": 1,
      "limit": 20,
      "total": 45,
      "pages": 3
    }
  }
}
```
page_texts.25:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#get-document]

#### Get Document

Retrieve a specific document by ID.

```http
GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

**Response:**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "doc_123456",
    "title": "Document Title",
    "filename": "research_paper.pdf",
    "content": "Full document content...",
    "size": 1048576,
    "status": "processed",
    "chunks": 15,
    "created_at": "2025-08-24T12:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2025-08-24T12:05:00Z",
    "metadata": {
      "author": "John Doe",
      "category": "research",
      "pages": 25,
      "language": "en"
    }
  }
}
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#delete-document]

#### Delete Document

Delete a document and all associated data.

```http
DELETE /api/v1/documents/{document_id}
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

**Response:**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Document deleted successfully"
}
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#search-documents]

#### Search Documents

```bash
curl -X POST "<base-url>/api/rag/v1/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "query": "What is machine learning?",
    "limit": 5,
    "include_ai_response": true
  }'
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#upload-document]

#### Upload Document

```bash

  -F "file=@research_paper.pdf" \

  -F 'metadata={"author": "John Doe", "category": "research"}'
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#rate-limiting]

## Rate Limiting

The RAG Service implements rate limiting to ensure fair usage and system stability.
page_texts.44:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#rate-limits]

### Rate Limits

| Endpoint Category   | Limit        | Window   |
| ------------------- | ------------ | -------- |
| Authentication      | 10 requests  | 1 minute |
| Search              | 100 requests | 1 hour   |
| Document Upload     | 20 requests  | 1 hour   |
| Document Management | 200 requests | 1 hour   |
| Chat                | 50 messages  | 1 hour   |
page_texts.45:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/07-api-reference-future.md#rate-limit-headers]

### Rate Limit Headers

All responses include rate limit information:

```http
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 95
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1629876543
X-RateLimit-Window: 3600
```
